record.question: What does the term "Police Officer" include under Section 2 (1)(j) of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011?
options: Any member of Mizoram Police constituted under the Mizoram Police Act, 2011
Any person appointed under any other law to perform police duties
Any member of Mizoram Police of the rank of Assistant Inspector of Police (ASI)and above
Any member of Mizoram Police Service (MPS)
record.explanation: Police Officer includes any member of the Mizoram Police constituted under the Act.
